meta.method: structured requirement representation based on dsl-core

definitions.subject: The regulated artefact to which the requirement applies, independent of implementing authority or governance structure
definitions.acceptance_criteria: Verifiable conditions that indicate that a requirement is fulfilled
definitions.verification_method: The method used to assess whether an acceptance criterion is met (e.g. inspection, review, test, audit)
definitions.verification_artefacts: Artefacts that must be available in order to verify an acceptance criterion

structure.subject: EU AI Act regulatory sandbox framework
structure.action: define technical and organisational interfaces between participating actors and systems

acceptance_criteria.statement: A documented interface inventory exists that lists participating actors/systems and the interfaces between them.
For each interface, the owning party and operational responsibility are explicitly stated.

structure.subject: EU AI Act regulatory sandbox framework
structure.action: support integration with existing standards and infrastructures relevant to the sandbox context

acceptance_criteria.statement: A standards and infrastructure register exists identifying the relevant standards and infrastructures for the sandbox context.
verification_artefacts: References to applicable standards and infrastructures

acceptance_criteria.statement: Integration points to the identified standards and infrastructures are documented and traceable to sandbox components.
verification_artefacts: Trace links between components and standards/infrastructure integration points

structure.subject: EU AI Act regulatory sandbox framework
structure.action: ensure consistent handling of identity and access across organisational boundaries within the sandbox

acceptance_criteria.statement: A documented identity and access model exists describing roles, permissions, and cross-organisation access boundaries.
Access decisions are enforced consistently across participating systems according to the documented model.
verification_artefacts: Access policy definitions (e.g. policy-as-code or configuration)

structure.subject: EU AI Act regulatory sandbox framework
structure.action: document the intended relationship between sandbox configurations and downstream production deployment contexts

acceptance_criteria.statement: A production relevance statement exists describing which sandbox characteristics are intended to align with production and which are intentionally different.
verification_artefacts: List of aligned characteristics and intentional deviations

acceptance_criteria.statement: For each intentional deviation from production, the rationale and expected impact on findings are documented.
verification_artefacts: Rationale and impact notes per deviation

structure.subject: EU AI Act regulatory sandbox framework
structure.action: define data sources and permitted data uses for sandbox activities

acceptance_criteria.statement: A data source register exists listing all data sources used in the sandbox, including origin and classification.
Permitted uses are explicitly documented per data source and linked to sandbox activities.
verification_artefacts: Links between data sources and sandbox activities

structure.subject: EU AI Act regulatory sandbox framework
structure.action: provide traceability of data flows within the sandbox environment

acceptance_criteria.statement: A data flow model exists showing ingestion, processing, storage, and outputs within the sandbox.
verification_artefacts: Data flow diagrams (human-readable) and/or machine-readable flow definitions

acceptance_criteria.statement: For each data flow, processing steps are traceable to responsible components and stated purposes.
verification_artefacts: Trace links from flow elements to components

structure.subject: EU AI Act regulatory sandbox framework
structure.action: define retention and deletion rules for data ingested into the sandbox

acceptance_criteria.statement: Retention periods are defined per data category and aligned with the permitted-use definitions.
verification_artefacts: Mapping between data categories and permitted uses

acceptance_criteria.statement: Deletion rules describe triggers, responsibilities, and verification of deletion outcomes.
verification_artefacts: Deletion verification mechanism (e.g. logs or attestations)

structure.subject: EU AI Act regulatory sandbox framework
structure.action: define how changes in legal or factual conditions affecting sandbox data are handled

acceptance_criteria.statement: A change-handling procedure exists for legal or factual condition changes that affect data permissions or validity.
verification_artefacts: Defined triggers and impact assessment steps

acceptance_criteria.statement: Decisions resulting from such changes are recorded and linked to affected datasets, data flows, and sandbox activities.
verification_artefacts: Trace links to datasets, flows, and activities

structure.subject: EU AI Act regulatory sandbox framework
structure.action: define a mechanism to document and apply requests to exclude previously used data from influencing system behaviour

acceptance_criteria.statement: A documented process exists to register exclusion requests for previously used data, including scope and rationale.
For each exclusion request, the applied mitigation or adjustment is documented and linked to the affected model or system version.
verification_artefacts: Trace links to affected model/system version identifiers

structure.subject: EU AI Act regulatory sandbox framework
structure.action: establish a shared security-by-design baseline applicable to sandbox operation

acceptance_criteria.statement: A security-by-design baseline exists defining common principles and minimum control expectations for sandbox operation.
Sandbox participants can reference the baseline when designing or operating sandbox components.

structure.subject: EU AI Act regulatory sandbox framework
structure.action: enable assessment of residual risks against the security-by-design baseline

acceptance_criteria.statement: A residual-risk assessment template or process exists that explicitly references the security-by-design baseline.
Residual risks are recorded with rationale and linked to the sandbox baseline version and relevant components.

structure.subject: EU AI Act regulatory sandbox framework
structure.action: maintain a versioned baseline of sandbox configurations and applied assumptions

acceptance_criteria.statement: A baseline artefact exists that records sandbox configuration and assumptions and is assigned a version identifier.
Changes to configuration or assumptions result in a new baseline version and are recorded as such.
verification_artefacts: Recorded changes linked to baseline versions

structure.subject: EU AI Act regulatory sandbox framework
structure.action: make changes to sandbox configurations traceable over time

acceptance_criteria.statement: A change log exists that records what changed, when, and why for sandbox configurations.
verification_artefacts: Timestamps and rationale fields in change log entries

acceptance_criteria.statement: Each change entry references the affected configuration elements and the resulting baseline version.

structure.subject: EU AI Act regulatory sandbox framework
structure.action: support reproducibility of sandbox findings by referencing a specific sandbox baseline version

acceptance_criteria.statement: Sandbox outputs include an explicit reference to the baseline version under which they were produced.
verification_artefacts: Output metadata containing baseline version identifier

acceptance_criteria.statement: The referenced baseline version can be retrieved and inspected to reconstruct the relevant configuration and assumptions.
verification_artefacts: Baseline archive/store keyed by version identifier

structure.subject: EU AI Act regulatory sandbox framework
structure.action: provide identity and access management for human participants in sandbox activities

acceptance_criteria.statement: Human participant roles are defined and mapped to permissions relevant to sandbox activities.
Access to sandbox resources is granted and revoked according to the defined roles and permissions.
verification_artefacts: Access audit evidence (e.g. logs or attestations)

structure.subject: EU AI Act regulatory sandbox framework
structure.action: provide identifiable and accountable service identities for technical services and automated components

acceptance_criteria.statement: Service identities are defined for technical services and automations that access sandbox resources.
Actions performed by service identities are traceable to the specific service identity used.
verification_artefacts: Service identity identifiers recorded in relevant log entries

structure.subject: EU AI Act regulatory sandbox framework
structure.action: define and maintain a transparency concept that describes scope, roles, system boundaries, data categories, applicable constraints, and participant-facing disclosures

acceptance_criteria.statement: A versioned transparency concept exists that defines scope, participating roles, system boundaries, and the sandbox’s purpose and constraints.
verification_artefacts: Baseline/version references linking the concept to sandbox baselines

acceptance_criteria.statement: The transparency concept lists data categories processed in the sandbox and the high-level purposes for processing.
Participant-facing disclosures are available in a human-readable form and linked to the corresponding sandbox baseline version.

structure.subject: EU AI Act regulatory sandbox framework
structure.action: define an explainability approach appropriate to the AI system type and risk context, including explicit limitations of the provided explanations

acceptance_criteria.statement: An explainability concept exists defining intended audiences and the explanation mechanisms provided for each audience.
For each explanation mechanism, documented limitations and uncertainty boundaries exist (what the explanation can and cannot support).
verification_artefacts: Explainability concept: limitations section per mechanism

acceptance_criteria.statement: The explainability concept is traceable to the sandbox baseline versions under which explanations are generated.
verification_artefacts: Links from sandbox outputs to baseline/version identifiers

structure.subject: EU AI Act regulatory sandbox framework
structure.action: assess and document bias and fairness risks within the sandbox scope, including measurement approach, test scope, and known limitations

acceptance_criteria.statement: A bias/fairness assessment exists defining what is measured, which dimensions or proxies are used, and what is out of scope.
Assessment results are documented with interpretation guidance and limitations (e.g., dataset representativeness, measurement constraints).
The assessment is traceable to the sandbox configuration/baseline under which it was performed.
verification_artefacts: Baseline/version reference in the assessment report
Links to relevant sandbox configuration identifiers

structure.subject: EU AI Act regulatory sandbox framework
structure.action: document mitigation strategies for identified bias/fairness risks and provide participant-facing guidance on residual risks and interpretation limits

acceptance_criteria.statement: A mitigation plan exists that maps identified bias/fairness risks to mitigation measures and responsible owners.
Participant-facing guidance exists describing residual bias/fairness risks and interpretation limits in clear language.
verification_artefacts: Link to corresponding mitigation plan version

acceptance_criteria.statement: Mitigation changes and guidance updates are versioned and linked to sandbox baselines.

structure.subject: EU AI Act regulatory sandbox framework
structure.action: implement and document data protection controls for any personal, sensitive, or regulated data used for training, fine-tuning, evaluation, or testing, including minimisation and appropriate transformations (e.g. pseudonymisation/anonymisation) where applicable

acceptance_criteria.statement: A data inventory exists listing datasets, categories, purposes (training/fine-tuning/evaluation/testing), permitted uses, and retention/deletion rules.
verification_artefacts: Lifecycle fields (purpose, permitted use, retention, deletion)

acceptance_criteria.statement: For each dataset, documented protective measures exist (access controls, minimisation steps, and transformations where applicable) including rationale when transformations are not applicable.
Evidence exists that retention/deletion rules can be executed and are auditable within the sandbox context.

structure.subject: EU AI Act regulatory sandbox framework
structure.action: where instruction-following or LLM-based components are used, perform structured testing for prompt injection and related AI-specific attack patterns, and maintain traceable remediation and regression evidence

acceptance_criteria.statement: A threat model exists that identifies trust boundaries, assets, attacker goals, and LLM/tool integration risks (where applicable).
A test plan exists that includes prompt injection/jailbreak scenarios, data exfiltration attempts, and tool misuse cases (where applicable).
Findings, mitigations, and regression results are versioned and linked to sandbox baselines.
